items.html: Now, this Hey, in gematria, is three Heys, for the Yud of the filling becomes two Heys, and thus they are three Heys, since there are three lines in the form of the Hey. Therefore the first Hey is in her three lines of KHB, and therefore this Hey is simple and principal; but the Yud of the filling of the Hey divides into two Heys as above, and they are in her VAK: the one in her three lines of HGT, and the last Hey in her three lines of NHY. And corresponding to them there are three other Heys of externality.
